sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Tactile, Auditory, Unaware), Fuinjutsu

system.description:
Using the same principles as Mind body disturbance, you emit a wave of psychic chakra that resets the connection of a creatures mind and body. All creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you, must make a Charisma saving throw.

If a hostile creature is Shadow Bound by an allied creature or the target of an allied creatures Human Boulder jutsu, this jutsu’s casting time becomes 1 Reaction, in response to either of those conditions being met. The bound or target creature treats their result as one degree worse.

Critical Success: Target takes 2d6 psychic damage.

Success: Targets takes 4d6 psychic damage and becomes Dazed.

Failure: Targets takes 8d6 psychic damage, and is Slowed and they gain 1 Mental Overwrite.

Critical Failure: Target takes 10d6 psychic damage, and is Stunned they gain 3 Mental Overwrite.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
